title: Rawafid Unicode display-risk regression corpus
basis: Unicode Standard Annex #9: Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm 17.0.0
Unicode Technical Standard #39: Unicode Security Mechanisms 17.0.0
scope: Independent regression vectors for the toolkit's deliberately limited display-risk diagnostics. This corpus is not copied from Unicode conformance data and does not claim UAX #9 or UTS #39 conformance.

cases.interpretation: legitimate mixed-language display text; diagnostic is context, not a maliciousness verdict

balanced isolation is structurally valid but explicit controls are still observable policy signals

ZWNJ can be linguistically legitimate in Arabic-script languages; the signal must not be treated as a verdict
